_comment: Runs quarantined from analysis. The tick log itself is append-only and untouched; this file records what must not be counted, and why. Honoured by fxlib.replay.load_ticks.

runs.reason: concurrent second collector during a --until smoke test; overlapped the live run 071353Z for ~2s and duplicated 33 ticks. The SingleWriterLock added the same day prevents recurrence.
